headline_marked: Kylian Mbappé [[wins two Golden Boots]] as Spain claims World Cup
headline: Kylian Mbappé wins two Golden Boots as Spain claims World Cup
summary: Mbappé becomes the first player in history to win the Golden Boot in two different World Cups, while Spain defeats Argentina 1-0 in the final.
details: Spain has won the 23rd FIFA World Cup, defeating Argentina 1-0 in the mega final. This victory marks Spain's first World Cup title in 16 years.
French star Kylian Mbappé has made history as the first footballer to win two Golden Boots in World Cup history.
Mbappé finished the tournament with 10 goals, including two goals scored in the third-place play-off match.
Entering the semi-finals, both Lionel Messi and Kylian Mbappé had 8 goals each. However, Messi's failure to score in the final ensured Mbappé's Golden Boot victory.
Mbappé previously won the Golden Boot at the 2022 Qatar World Cup, making him the first player to achieve this feat in consecutive tournaments.
The French forward also maintained his record as the all-time leading goalscorer in World Cup history with a total of 22 goals.
caption:
Kylian Mbappé makes history! He becomes the first player ever to win two World Cup Golden Boots.

Spain has won the 23rd FIFA World Cup, defeating Argentina 1-0 in the mega final. This victory marks Spain's first World Cup title in 16 years.

French star Kylian Mbappé has made history as the first footballer to win two Golden Boots in World Cup history.

Mbappé finished the tournament with 10 goals, including two goals scored in the third-place play-off match.

Entering the semi-finals, both Lionel Messi and Kylian Mbappé had 8 goals each. However, Messi's failure to score in the final ensured Mbappé's Golden Boot victory.

Mbappé previously won the Golden Boot at the 2022 Qatar World Cup, making him the first player to achieve this feat in consecutive tournaments.

The French forward also maintained his record as the all-time leading goalscorer in World Cup history with a total of 22 goals.

headline: Concerns rise as Salman Khan appears unwell in video
summary: Fans are expressing worry after a recent clip showing the Bollywood superstar looking visibly distressed or ill.
details: A recent video circulating online has sparked concerns among fans regarding Salman Khan's health.
